name: no-ibis
description: For a body whose image stabilizer is broken: the firmware treats the body as one without a stabilizer, so it does not start or check the unit at power-on. Three bytes, the patch tested by the reporter of issue 7 on their body. See experiments/2026-11-27-no-ibis/NOTES.md.

ops._note: 0x7E506FE2, called once by Usr0 at 0x7E503FA0: `mov 1,d0` -> `mov 0,d0`, so the stabilizer type 0x604F3464 is 0. BC start 0x7E53E130 then does not start the stage, and the updater prints NON_STAB and skips only the stabilizer's own firmware

BC sync request 30 (0x7E53DCD3, sent by the mechanism power control 0x7E517207/0x7E5172CE): the `bne` after `cmp 2,d0` (damage byte 0x60503AD1) -> two `nop`, so the request always takes the existing 'unavailable' path (reply 0x8202) and is never sent to the unit; it does not check the stabilizer type
